Soil & Nutrition Water & Mineral Uptake Transport Mechanisms
Plant Nutrition Outline
explanation: This slide provides an outline of the plant nutrition and transport topics to be covered in Unit 7.2. These topics are divided into three main subdivisions: Soil & Nutrition, Water & Mineral Uptake, and Transport Mechanisms.

questions.q: Which of the following is listed as one of the three main subdivisions under the Plant Nutrition Outline?
questions.exp: The outline specifies three main subdivisions: 'Soil & Nutrition', 'Water & Mineral Uptake', and 'Transport Mechanisms'.
